output.headline: Blum's early goal gives Northgate Rovers a 1-0 win
output.text: What a tense one! Northgate Rovers took the lead in the 23rd minute. Emre Kaya played a lovely long pass to Oscar Blum, who smashed it home from close range. After that, Northgate Rovers kept hold of the ball more and tried to stay patient, while Southmere United pushed forward with wing play and crosses. Southmere United won the ball back again and again, and the pressure grew late on. Blum nearly added a second in the 65th minute but missed the target. Southmere United never found a way through, so that single goal was enough. Blum was the standout, scoring the winner and working hard all game. Full time: Northgate Rovers 1, Southmere United 0.
